create.name: Keri Pederson
create.bio:
Keri Pederson is an insight meditation teacher in the Theravada Buddhist tradition, based on Vashon Island near Seattle. She came to meditation in 1998 through yoga and a wish to understand why people suffer, and her first silent retreats were in the S. N. Goenka tradition. Since then she has sat retreats with lay and monastic teachers in the United States, Thailand and India. She began teaching in 2007 at the invitation of Rodney Smith, and was later authorised as a retreat teacher after the four-year training run by Spirit Rock and the Insight Meditation Society.

Today she is one of the community guiding teachers of Seattle Insight Meditation Society, where she gives regular Monday evening talks, leads ceremonies such as refuges and forgiveness, and meets students one to one for practice interviews. Her talks range over the Buddha's core teachings, from mindfulness and patience to joy, tranquillity and the path to awakening, and are shared as recordings on the society's website and podcast. Alongside her teaching she works in elder care and describes herself as a student of the dharma first.

free_resources.title: Dispassion, Passion, and the Feeling Life of Awakening
free_resources.description: A recorded Monday evening dharma talk from October 2026 on how feeling and desire fit into the path of awakening. Free to stream from Seattle Insight's talk library.

free_resources.title: Contentment with What's Here Already
free_resources.description: A short evening talk on finding ease in present experience rather than reaching for the next thing. Recorded at Seattle Insight and free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Spiritual Playfulness and Irrepressible Joy
free_resources.description: A talk on joy as a factor of awakening and a lighter, more playful attitude to practice. Free recording from the society's podcast.

free_resources.title: Embodied Samadhi
free_resources.description: A talk on settling and collecting the mind through attention to the body. Free to stream.

free_resources.title: The Immediacy of Mindfulness
free_resources.description: An evening talk on meeting each moment directly with mindful attention. Recorded at Seattle Insight and freely available.
